say:0:1620617001:1.text: The pale figure appears again. His head is bowed, and the air around him feels heavy, like the room itself is grieving.
say:0:1620617001:1.source_cn: 你们又看到了那个苍白的身影，他低垂着头，空气中弥漫着无...
say:0:1620617001:1.male: The pale figure appears again. His head is bowed, and the air around him feels heavy, like the room itself is grieving.
say:0:1620617001:1.female: The pale figure appears again. His head is bowed, and the air around him feels heavy, like the room itself is grieving.

say:1:1620617002:0.text: A faint voice echoes, like a piece of memory from the past.
say:1:1620617002:0.source_cn: 声音幽幽地回荡，像是从遥远的过去透出的一段断裂记忆。

say:4:1620617004:0.text: <style="highlight">"I just wanted my students to master magic... but I never saw how far they were being pushed..."</style>

say:5:1620617005:0.text: <style="highlight">"I wasn't teaching. I was driving them toward disaster..."</style>

say:7:1620617006:0.text: This time, the echo isn't angry. It sounds low and weak, filled with regret and sorrow.
say:7:1620617006:0.source_cn: 相比刚才的训斥，这段回声低沉而无力，仿佛夹杂着无尽的悔...

say:9:1620617007:0.text: He was shouting just a moment ago, and now... he sounds so sad.
say:9:1620617007:0.source_cn: 刚才还在训斥呢，怎么一转眼就变成这样了？

say:10:1620617008:0.text: An echo is only a fragment of memory. A moment from the past, frozen in magic.
say:10:1620617008:0.source_cn: 回声不过是魔力形成的残影，你可以理解为过去发生过的一个片段。

say:11:1620617009:0.text: That makes sense... we just don't know what happened between those moments.
say:11:1620617009:0.source_cn: 也对，只是我们不清楚这中间发生了什么。

say:12:1620617010:0.text: Honestly... when he was shouting earlier, I just thought he was another strict, cold professor with anger issues.
say:12:1620617010:0.source_cn: 不过……刚才么凶巴巴的，我还以为是那种不近人情的严厉老师呢。

say:13:1620617011:0.text: Yeah... I'm not sure what to think anymore.

choice_prompt:14:1620617011.text: Yeah... I'm not sure what to think anymore.

say:15:1620617012:0.text: I used to think an echo came from just one strong emotion, like anger or guilt. But this one... this is more than that.
say:15:1620617012:0.source_cn: 我也是这么想的，不过我一直以为执念只是单一的情绪，但这...

say:16:1620617013:0.text: Either way, we should keep going. We might never get another chance to study something like this up close.
say:16:1620617013:0.source_cn: 无论如何，我们得继续调查，这可是难得的学习机会。

say:17:1620617014:0.text: That's so like you, Loran. Everyone else is scared, and you're thinking about what we can learn from it.
say:17:1620617014:0.source_cn: 不愧是你，洛兰，这种时候还想着学习。

say:18:1620617015:0.text: Naturally. Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's keep going. We're right behind you.
say:18:1620617015:0.male: Naturally. Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's keep going. We're right behind you.
say:18:1620617015:0.female: Naturally. Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's keep going. We're right behind you.

choice:14:0:1.text: It could be the key to releasing the echo.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 这也许是破除执念的关键
choice:14:0:1.male: It could be the key to releasing the echo.
choice:14:0:1.female: It could be the key to releasing the echo.
